protocol.experiment: Read-only CH/Child gate comparison across seven selected MOLTs

features.label: Token child in personal or familial contexts
Culinary and Proper Noun "Ch" Word Starts

protocol.activation: Natural thresholded scalar gate at each transform own layer: standardize residual after attention, before post_attention_layernorm; raw = dot(z,e)+bias; gate=raw if raw>theta and raw>0, otherwise zero.
protocol.scope: Five CH-starting target spellings in both exact existing upper/lower few-shot tasks (ten prompts). Child is compared to other CH words; this pilot does not include non-CH word controls. No interventions or probe changes.
protocol.plotting: Plot each input target subtoken separately. cheef is split into che and ef; do not silently average, sum, or take max across those tokens. Shared raw gate color scale; numerical scales across transforms are not calibrated causal strengths.
protocol.verification: Pinned full base hashes, pinned gate slices, unhooked native generation reproduced against saved baseline, read-only hook replay token-identical, independent CPU gate recomputation on saved standardized inputs. Individual prompts only.
protocol.resource: Reuse retained SPAR RTX3090 instance 56698356; no new rental or lifecycle action.
